summary: migration_bridge.py materializes only the declared RED test for slices W0-W6; templates target specific future APIs and failure assertions; validates implementation contract, slice ID, declared selector, planned test file, and allowed test write set; requires snapshot_paths exactly [selector]; plan must reside under repository execution-plans; target path must be relative, within repository, and exclude traversal, logs, and execution-plans components; existing target must exactly match template or operation fails; creates parent directories and UTF-8 LF file when absent; CLI requires --materialize-only and emits materialized status with slice ID/path and empty authorization list; unknown slices, undeclared templates, unavailable APIs, invalid paths, conflicts, or non-materialize mode raise errors; no Quick Dev slice is started.
